description: Get the transcript of a video or podcast episode from its page or a transcript source, and summarize, quote or search what was said, with timestamps or speakers when available. Use when the user shares or names a video, podcast, talk, interview or episode and asks what it says, for notes, key points or quotes, or asks which episodes discussed a topic, even without naming a tool.
